text: {"assertions":["A silent drop bug in notifications/push/dispatch.py was caused by the config loader reading the wrong environment file.","The silent drop issue only affected accounts in the five percent rollout bucket.","The fix was implemented in PR #1281 on branch fix/silent-drop-1 and made environment selection explicit with failed-closed behavior on ambiguity.","The bug could be reproduced by dispatching to a device token that was rotated.","The flaky test in tests/notifications/test_dispatch.py improved from 25 failures per 100 runs to zero failures."]}
